episode_summary: In this episode, Valerie Fitzgerald shares her inspiring journey from a single mother with no contacts to a top luxury real estate agent. She discusses the importance of embracing fear, leveraging relationships, and using AI to build a successful business. Her story is a testament to resilience and the power of reinvention in the real estate industry.
